description: Censys host view for an IPv4 address: the services, ports and protocols Censys has observed on it with their last scan time and detected software, plus autonomous system, location, network owner and reverse DNS, from the Censys Platform API. Related tools on this server, for a different need: security_rdp_exposure_check when you need to check Shodan's passive scan records for TCP port 3389; security_smb_exposure_test when you need to check Shodan's passive scan records for TCP port 445. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_censys_exposure
title: Censys host view for an IPv4 address: the services, ports
